# book_tag (Resource)

The tag records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `name` (String) Display name of the tag.
- `owner_id` (String) Organization that owns the tag.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free text description of the tag.
- `keywords` (List of String) Words search matches beside the name to find the objects carrying the tag.
